title.zh: 实际履行导出同律机会下界
title.en: Fulfillment implies a same-law chance floor

claim.zh: 有限配对情形中，逐情形覆盖有效需求且旧支持仍工作的目标，推出同一正总权重下的质量下界；对所有自然数权重保持质量等价于覆盖。
claim.en: In a finite coupled domain, pointwise coverage of demand with still-working old support yields a mass floor under one positive total weight; preservation for all natural weights characterizes inclusion.

hypotheses.zh: 有限情形列表、自然数事件权重、目标 demand AND oldWorks 及 Fulfilled；概率解释需正总权重。
hypotheses.en: Finite event enumeration, natural event weights, target demand AND oldWorks, and Fulfilled; probability interpretation requires positive total weight.

correspondence.zh: 配对、时段、覆盖与旧承担有效性需要证据；权重不是伦理重要性。
correspondence.en: Coupling, time window, coverage and validity of the undertaking need evidence; weights are not ethical importance.

detail.zh: J3 支持其承担解释；纯质量不等式没有这个规范前提。
detail.en: J3 supports the undertaking interpretation; the pure mass inequality does not itself require that normative premise.

detail.zh: 同一法则下同成功率不代表逐情形履行；事件修复的定义不保证及时有权限的实际实施。
detail.en: Equal success under one law need not fulfill the undertaking pointwise; an event-level repair definition does not ensure timely authorized implementation.

limitations.zh: 同一法则下同成功率不代表逐情形履行；事件修复的定义不保证及时有权限的实际实施。
limitations.en: Equal success under one law need not fulfill the undertaking pointwise; an event-level repair definition does not ensure timely authorized implementation.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述为核心一般定律的实例。核心（Becoming.Weighted）无前提地证明：在列出的定义域上，事件的质量在每一权重下随包含而不减（mass_mono），加入正权重的条目时严格上升（mass_lt_of_added）；每一权重都不使事件质量下降，恰当事件在定义域上被包含（every_weighting_iff），只计一个条目的权重（dirac）区分事件。ChanceAdequacy 的质量即核心的质量（chance_mass_eq），所以 all_weights_preserve_mass_iff 即 every_weighting_iff（all_weights_preserve_mass_iff_by_core），机会下限即两次 mass_mono（fulfillment_floor_by_core），公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；桥接自此导入 ChanceAdequacy，脊柱运行将其作为继承模块编译。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine as an instance of a general core law. With no premise the core (Becoming.Weighted) proves that on a listed domain the mass of an event follows inclusion under every weighting (mass_mono) and rises strictly where an entry of positive weight is added (mass_lt_of_added), and that every weighting keeps an event's mass from falling exactly where the event is included on the domain (every_weighting_iff), the weightings counting one entry (dirac) telling events apart. ChanceAdequacy's mass is the core's (chance_mass_eq), so all_weights_preserve_mass_iff is every_weighting_iff (all_weights_preserve_mass_iff_by_core) and the chance floor is mass_mono twice (fulfillment_floor_by_core), with empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the bridge now imports ChanceAdequacy, which the spine run compiles as an inherited module.

Becoming.Courses is compiled and audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T172257.067968Z), with empty axiom reports.
